correctness.rationale: Logarithmic differentiation yields exact rational polynomial coefficients for A_{5,111+125X}(39). Finite exact-arithmetic certificate replays and verifies c0 valuation 5, c1/c2 valuation 4 with normalized units 3, and all higher coefficients valuation at least 6. Therefore normalized polynomial is integral on Z_5 with reduction 3X(X+1). Its roots 0 and 4 are simple, with unique 5-adic lifts, and a unit difference quotient gives the exact valuation formula. Independent Euler-product coefficient calculations confirm eight sample tuple orders; infinite quantifiers rest on the polynomial identity and Hensel lemma, not numerical sampling.

originality.rationale: Maity Theorem 3.3 gives only divisibility by 5^4 over complete progressions; it neither classifies exact valuations of A_{5,111+125i}(39) nor parameter-root multiplicities. A distinct prior exact-saturation result concerns common exponents at 21+125i across four different progressions and does not imply these two simple roots. Searches of mathematical-record indexes, arXiv, the publisher journals and OEIS-related web queries found no explicit or stronger determination. Main residual priority risk is the inaccessible full 2025 Tang article.

value.rationale: The coefficient at 39 is the first natural index of a recently proved high-order 5-core congruence progression. Its previously unresolved exact 5-adic order varies through two distinct simple branches of arbitrarily high depth, with complete natural densities 3/5 and 8/5^(e+1). These fibers give an effective necessary filter for all future uniform lifts, rather than a decorative arbitrary coefficient, and sharply separate the baseline 5^4 regime from exceptional parameters. No general all-coefficient lift or publication-sized implication is asserted.
